headlines: TSMC September revenue +54.6% y/y, record Q3 sales; Samsung guides record Q3 operating profit (per Stocktwits post)
Chips bouncing premarket after Thursday's OpenAI revenue scare; NVDA up on reported BNP Paribas Strong Buy upgrade
Futures higher as oil and yields calm; Brent near $103 after reported Trump comment on Iran; Fed's Waller and Musalem reportedly signal more hikes
Telecoms sharply lower premarket: TMUS -7.2%, VZ -4.7%, T -5.9% (cause not found); AAPL -2.8%, DAL -2.4%

rumors.text: FT reportedly said OpenAI annualized revenue is about $20B below what it signaled; crowd now says chip selloff is overdone after strong TSMC and Samsung data
rumors.why: If AI demand is weaker than signaled, chip and AI-capex names stay under pressure; strong TSMC/Samsung numbers argue the opposite

rumors.text: Fed officials Waller and Musalem both reportedly signaled more rate hikes are likely
rumors.why: More hikes would pressure valuations and long bonds

rumors.text: Trump said the US would not attack Iran before the midterms, pushing Brent down about 1%
rumors.why: Lower geopolitical risk and oil would support equities and hurt energy

rumors.text: Nvidia won a Strong Buy upgrade from BNP Paribas
rumors.why: Supports a chip bounce and Nasdaq lift

rumors.text: Posters see SPY call wall at 778-780; a hold above 780 could squeeze higher, while failing 776.84 points to 769.7
rumors.why: Options positioning could pin or pull the index around those strikes

plays.reason: Futures were up 0.4% and chips are bouncing on TSMC/Samsung strength while SPY is slightly red; dips are being bought, but Fed hike talk and resistance near 778-780 cap the edge

readings.whats_new: SPY is up from about 772.7 an hour-plus ago to 775.86 (-0.17% on the day), with QQQ -0.76% (was -1.5%) as chips rebound on TSMC and Samsung data. Fear and greed is steady at 38 and VIX slipped to 15.15. New: telecoms (TMUS, VZ, T) are sharply lower premarket for an unknown reason, and Fed hike comments plus Iran/oil headlines are circulating.
